Description.SourceString:
Comrades! I have had it up to here with your complaints about the Pescaling Ring and how it does not fit onto your flippers! If the pitiful humans can wear rings on their protuberances then penguins can do the same. To claim otherwise is to say that penguins are less than humans, and that is punishable by DEATH.

Wear your ring with pride, comrades. Bunch your flippers, crush it onto your beaks, or swallow it whole. We are proud, ring-bearing people!
